info.title: Sentinel Provisioning
info.description: Sentinel Provisioning REST API for Rhino Sentinel (Sentinel Express), Alianza's real-time converged-services platform for network operators. Exposed by REM (Rhino Element Manager), the API provisions Sentinel service-layer resources -- subscriber data, service plans, session types, subscriptions, and home zone routing -- as REST resources scoped by a Rhino instance and, for subscriber-scoped resources, a Sentinel selection key.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 24 of 44 operations in the full hand-built reference spec, covering the 5 core subscriber/service/routing provisioning resources (Plans, Session Types, Subscriptions, Subscriber Data records, and Home Zone zones) and dropping the Subscriber Data and Home Zone SQL/lookup admin-configuration sub-resources. See the repo README for the resource breakdown and the full spec.

servers.description: Sentinel Provisioning REST API server. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically -- set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/rem/sentinel/api" (REM's default mount point for the Sentinel Provisioning REST API).
